plan.title: eRFX RFQ-stage required T&C vendor submission

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test company.
Allow the vendor to be added during event creation.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Create the Technical + RFQ two-stage event required to verify stage-scoped terms.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
rfp needs its own template
Add one product for the vendor quote.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
rfq needs its own template
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Add one QA vendor to both stages.
Publish the completed two-stage event.
Confirm publication reached a real project page.
Open the invited vendor portal while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the technical round to verify RFQ-only clauses are not shown there.
Assert the RFQ clause is absent from the technical-stage vendor view.
Assert the optional RFQ clause is also absent from the technical-stage vendor view.
Return to the buyer console before using the combined two-stage bid action.
Have the invited vendor answer the technical stage and quote 100 on the RFQ, as one combined portal bid.
Confirm the vendor submission was accepted.
Return to the vendor portal to inspect the RFQ round after submission.
Open the RFQ pricing round where the stage-scoped clauses should be visible.
Assert the required clause appears in the RFQ vendor flow.
Assert the optional clause appears in the RFQ vendor flow without independently claiming its checkbox state.
